messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PagerDuty P1 triggered for realtime-infer-canary: 5xx rate > 8% for 5m across canary pool. Auto-page sent to #eng-oncall and #incidents. (svc=realtime-infer, variant=quant-8bit, env=prod-canary)

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert: 'Canary 5xx spike — realtime-infer' — Incident ID PD-24578 — page at 2026-03-15T03:24:28Z

Maya (eng-runtime): seeing same in graphs, p50/p95 spike, KV cache misses up. Rolling deploy just hit canary ~2m ago. Can confirm failure mode is `long-tail 5xx` from kernel timeouts on quant path.

Amber (oncall): acked PD-24578 — I'm on rotation. What's impact to customers? Any hits on hosted API keys?

Raj (sre): checking logs now — 5xxs concentrated on region us-west-2, model variant quant-8bit. ~2% of overall traffic but 100% of canary traffic. No API key correlation yet. Logs show `rpc: inference:error: handler timeout` and intermittent `segfault` in some pods.

Lex (prodeng): if it's quant kernel maybe related to the recent kernel upgrade in release v2.13.0. We should stop the rollout to remaining regions. Maya can you pause rollout and collect pod core dumps?

Maya (eng-runtime): running `deployctl scale --canary 0` to drain canary pods. Also `kubectl rollout pause deployment/realtime-infer` in canary namespace. Pushing command now:
``
kubectl -n canary rollout pause deploy/realtime-infer
deployctl revert --release v2.13.0 --target canary
```

incident-bot: Action logged: rollout pause requested by Maya. Attach runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/canary-rollback

Amber (oncall): Paging sequence: PD -> Amber ack -> Maya notified -> Raj -> Escalate to Eng Lead if not acked in 5m.

Maya (eng-runtime): pod core dump upload started to s3://redwood-incidents/PD-24578/cores

Raj (sre): I'm attaching quick telemetry: `curl https://telemetry.redwood/api/metrics?query=5xx_rate&svc=realtime-infer&env=canary` shows spike peaked at 12% at 03:25Z. Customer Impact: 0.8% of production API requests returned 5xx (mostly canary customers). CS to be notified.

Customer Support - Nina: FYI — I will open a slack thread to CS and draft a message for affected customers. ETA 10m.

Lex (prodeng): If rollback clears errors we can resume. Maya, if rollback doesn't clear within 10m escalate to kernel team @kernel-team.

Maya (eng-runtime): rollback in progress: `deployctl rollback realtime-infer --to-tag v2.12.4 --namespace canary` — rolling pods terminating.

pagerduty-bot: PD-24578 acknowledged by Amber at 03:27Z

Maya (eng-runtime): pods ending, new pods from v2.12.4 coming up. Monitoring logs.

Raj (sre): new pods up. 5xx rate dropping — current canary 5xx=0.9% at 03:31Z. Looks like rollback mitigated.

Amber (oncall): Good. Keeping page open until stable for 15m. Notify CS to hold off external comms until we confirm root cause.

Maya (eng-runtime): Collecting diffs, kernel change in v2.13.0 includes `quant-matrix-opt` which looks suspect. Creating issue: https://go/redwood/issue/INF-3123

Lex (prodeng): Save logs and core dumps; we'll run postmortem. Assigning owners: Maya (runtime), Raj (sre), Lex (prodeng), Kernel team watch.

incident-bot: Incident PD-24578 status updated: mitigation in progress — rollback executed. Next update in 10m or earlier if changed.

Amber (oncall): Thanks all. Maya ping me when cores uploaded. I'll close the PD once stable for 15m.

Customer Support - Nina: Drafted customer note, will hold until Amber OKs. Tagging affected customer orgs: org-104, org-209.

Maya (eng-runtime): cores uploaded: s3://redwood-incidents/PD-24578/cores (3 files). Running `gdb` analysis next.

Raj (sre): follow-up telemetry shows steady baseline. Marking last_message_ts
